types.description: Abstract app base: the attributes every app.* shares. Not authored directly: an `app.base` node fails to load (ERR_ABSTRACT_SUBTYPE_AUTHORED).

attrs.name: calls
attrs.description: The apps and outside systems this app calls. Each entry names an app.* or system.external node: a bare name is one in the same system (an outside system may also be declared at the document root); `System.child` names one in another system. A name that resolves to nothing, or to another kind of node, fails the load (ERR_SYSTEMS_UNRESOLVED_REF). Who may reach whom is derived from this list, so it is the list to keep current.

attrs.name: needs
attrs.description: The resources this app uses. Each entry names a resource.* node: a bare name is a resource of the same system; `System.resource` (or `pkg::System.resource`) names one in another. A name that resolves to nothing, or to a node that is not a resource, fails the load (ERR_SYSTEMS_UNRESOLVED_REF).

attrs.name: settings
attrs.description: The settings groups this app reads, by name (an object.settings of the config pack). Recorded by name only: this pack does not require the config pack, so the name is not resolved here.

attrs.name: engine
attrs.description: The product behind the resource, lower case: postgres, mysql, sqlite, redis, s3, r2. A platform generator reads it to pick the platform's own resource; this pack does not close the list.

attrs.name: managedBy
attrs.description: Who provisions it. platform: the platform an app deploys to creates it beside the app (a platform database). external: it exists outside that platform and is reached by settings (a bucket at another provider). Absent means platform.

attrs.name: version
attrs.description: The engine's major version, as a string (`18`).

types.description: Abstract system base: the shared root of system.internal and system.external. Not authored directly: a `system.base` node fails to load (ERR_ABSTRACT_SUBTYPE_AUTHORED).

A system someone else runs that an app calls: a payment provider, a chat platform, a model API. Named so an app's @calls can resolve to it; its address and credentials are settings, never attributes here.
types.whenToUse: Any third-party service an app depends on. Declare it inside the system that calls it, or at the document root when several systems share it.

types.description: A system this team builds and runs: the apps it is made of, the resources they use, and the outside systems they call. It answers what exists and what talks to what, and holds no deploy facts (those are the delivery pack's). Its apps and resources are addressed from outside it as `System.child` (`Shop.web`), or `pkg::System.child` from another package.
types.whenToUse: Every product or service that has at least one app. One system per product; a system documentation explorer and every deploy generator start here.
